settings.sensitivity: sum over the time (or probability) and the parameters of |d f / d log(theta)|, central differences with relative step 1e-20; 0 where the value is exact (an edge)

skipped.Bernoulli: two mass points; its values are p and 1 - p
skipped.FixedEventProbability: two mass points; its values are p, 1 - p
skipped.CustomDistribution: user-supplied hazard; accuracy is the user's
skipped.Discretize: built from a continuous distribution's sf, which is checked here
skipped.MixtureModel: a fitted combination of the distributions here
skipped.RoystonParmar: a fitted spline model, not a closed-form distribution
